description: This file contains a React functional component called 'FilmStrip' used to display a visual film strip for browsing screencast frames within a trace viewer. It manages layout, rendering frames, and showing hover previews of images and actions related to trace pages.

methods.name: FilmStrip
methods.description: Main React component rendering a film strip viewer for trace screencast frames with hover preview support.

methods.name: FilmStripLane
methods.description: Subcomponent rendering a lane of frames for a specific page in the trace, including frame calculation and rendering.

methods.name: timeComparator
methods.description: Comparator function for frames based on timestamp.

methods.name: inscribe
methods.description: Calculates scaled size to inscribe a rectangle within a given area while preserving aspect ratio.
